access_hour.description: Hour of the day when the transaction was submitted (0-23).

is_weekend.description: Binary flag indicating whether the event occurred on a weekend (1) or weekday (0).

time_elapsed_from_last_tx.description: Time elapsed since actor's prior transaction. Strictly positive.

role_escalation_index.description: Degree of divergence between requested action and actor's authorized role (0.0: normal, 0.5: unusual, 1.0: violation, 2.0: severe escalation).

rolling_event_frequency_1h.description: Number of operations initiated by this actor in the trailing 60 minutes.

rolling_failure_rate_24h.description: Proportion of failed attempts over total attempts in the last 24h (failed_attempts / total_attempts).

asset_sensitivity_tier.description: Classification tier of the asset (0: PUBLIC, 1: PRIVATE, 2: CONFIDENTIAL).

is_write_operation.description: Binary indicator for state-mutating operations (1) vs read-only operations (0).

actor_to_asset_relationship_depth.description: Relationship depth between actor and target asset (0: direct owner, 1: manager/admin, 2: 3rd-party, 3: unauthorized/unrelated).

user_role.description: Role assigned to the actor initiating the blockchain transaction.

label.description: High-level binary label for ground-truth evaluation only.

anomaly_scenario.description: Specific attack or behavioral anomaly archetype.
